text: Good morning, thank you for calling customer service. My name is Daniel, how may I help you today?
Hi, I'd like to check something on my savings account, please.
Before we continue, may I have your full name and date of birth for verification?
Sure, my name is Alex Tan and I was born on the fourteenth of March.
Thank you. Could you also confirm the last four digits of your registered mobile number?
Of course, it ends with seven two nine one.
Thank you for waiting. I have verified your identity, so we can proceed now.
Sorry, could you repeat that? The line is a bit unclear on my side.
For security reasons, please do not share your one-time password with anyone, including our staff.
Okay, understood. I just want to make sure my account is safe.
Can you tell me the current balance of my savings account?
Certainly. Your available balance is two thousand four hundred and fifty dollars.
That seems lower than I expected. Was there a recent withdrawal?
I can see a withdrawal of three hundred dollars at an ATM yesterday evening.
Yes, that was me. I forgot about it, thank you.
Would you like me to send a summary of your recent transactions by SMS?
Is my salary credited already? It usually comes in on the twenty-fifth.
Yes, your salary was credited this morning at around nine o'clock.
Great, and what about the balance of my fixed deposit?
Your fixed deposit will mature next month, and the interest will be added automatically.
Hello, I think I lost my debit card at the shopping mall this afternoon.
I'm sorry to hear that. I will block the card right away to protect your account.
Please do. I'm worried someone might use it.
The card has been blocked. No transactions were made after your last purchase at two p.m.
That's a relief. How do I get a replacement card?
A new card will be mailed to your registered address within five to seven working days.
Is there a fee for the replacement?
For the first replacement this year, the fee is waived.
Can I still withdraw cash before the new card arrives?
Yes, you can withdraw cash at any branch counter with your identity card.
We are calling about an unusual transaction on your credit card. Did you make a purchase overseas today?
No, I didn't. I haven't left the country in months.
Thank you for confirming. I will cancel this card and raise a dispute for the transaction.
How much was the charge? I'm really worried now.
The charge was eight hundred and ninety dollars at an online electronics store.
I got a text message asking me to click a link yesterday. Could that be related?
It might be. Please never click on links in unexpected messages, and delete that message.
Will I get my money back?
Once the investigation is complete, the amount will be credited back to your account.
Thank you for calling me so quickly. I really appreciate it.
I need to transfer five hundred dollars to my brother's account at another bank.
Sure. Have you already added your brother as a payee in the mobile app?
Not yet. Can you help me do it over the phone?
For your safety, new payees can only be added through the app or at a branch.
I made a transfer this morning, but the money hasn't arrived yet.
Transfers to other banks can take up to one working day to be processed.
What is my daily transfer limit at the moment?
Your current daily limit is three thousand dollars. You can change it in the app settings.
I sent money to the wrong account by mistake. What should I do?
Please stay on the line. I will file a recall request with the receiving bank immediately.
I want to set up a monthly payment for my electricity bill.
Certainly. Would you like the payment to be made from your current account or your credit card?
From my current account, on the first day of every month.
The standing instruction has been created and will start next month.
My phone bill payment failed last week. Can you tell me why?
It failed because the account balance was not sufficient at that time.
Can I cancel a scheduled payment that I set up yesterday?
Yes, I have cancelled it for you. You will receive a confirmation message shortly.
Is there any charge for paying bills through the hotline?
No, paying bills through our hotline or mobile app is completely free.
I'm interested in a personal loan. What is the current interest rate?
Our personal loan currently starts from three point eight percent per year.
How much can I borrow, and for how long?
You can borrow up to four times your monthly income, for a period of one to five years.
What documents do I need to apply?
You will need your identity card and your latest three months of salary slips.
How long does it take to get approval?
Most applications are approved within two working days.
Can I repay the loan early without a penalty?
Early repayment is allowed, but a small fee of one percent of the remaining amount applies.
I'm planning to buy my first home and want to know more about your home loans.
Congratulations. Are you looking for a fixed rate or a floating rate package?
I'm not sure. What is the difference between the two?
A fixed rate stays the same for a few years, while a floating rate moves with the market.
Can I refinance my existing home loan with your bank?
Yes, and we will cover the legal fees if the loan amount is above a certain level.
My monthly instalment went up this month. Why did that happen?
Your package is on a floating rate, and the reference rate increased last quarter.
Can I speak to a mortgage specialist about my options?
Of course. I will arrange for a specialist to call you back within one working day.
I would like to increase the limit on my credit card.
Sure. May I know the new limit you have in mind and the reason for the increase?
I'm travelling next month and expect to spend more than usual.
I can offer a temporary increase for thirty days. Would that work for you?
There is an annual fee on my statement. Can it be waived?
Since you are a long-time customer, I have waived the annual fee for this year.
How do I redeem my reward points?
You can redeem them for vouchers or air miles in the rewards section of the app.
When is the due date for this month's payment?
Your payment is due on the eighteenth. The minimum amount is fifty dollars.
I'm going to Japan next week. Do I need to inform the bank before using my card there?
It's a good idea. I have noted your travel dates so your card will not be blocked.
What is the fee for using my debit card overseas?
There is a foreign currency fee of three point two five percent per transaction.
Can I withdraw local cash from ATMs abroad?
Yes, but please make sure overseas withdrawals are activated in the app before you leave.
My card was declined at a hotel in Bangkok. Can you check what happened?
The transaction was declined because overseas usage was switched off. I have turned it on now.
Do you offer travel insurance with the credit card?
Yes, travel insurance is included when you pay for the full air ticket with this card.
I've moved to a new place and need to update my mailing address.
I can help with that. Please tell me your new address, including the postal code.
I also changed my mobile number. How do I update it?
For security, mobile numbers can only be changed at a branch or through the app with your digital token.
Can you update my email address so I get statements electronically?
Done. From next month, your statements will be sent to your new email address.
My surname has changed after marriage. What do I need to bring?
Please visit any branch with your identity card and your marriage certificate.
Will my old cards still work after the address change?
Yes, your cards remain valid. Only the mailing address on our records will change.
I can't log in to the mobile banking app. It keeps saying my password is wrong.
Your account is locked after three failed attempts. I can send you a reset link now.
I didn't receive the one-time password on my phone.
Please check that your phone has signal. I will resend the code in one minute.
The app crashes every time I try to open my account summary.
Please update the app to the latest version and restart your phone.
How do I set up the digital token on my new phone?
Open the app on your new phone, choose the token option, and follow the steps on screen.
Is it safe to use online banking on public Wi-Fi?
We recommend using your mobile data instead of public Wi-Fi for banking.
I was charged a late fee, but I paid my bill on time. This is really frustrating.
I'm sorry for the inconvenience. Let me check the payment date on your account.
This is the third time this has happened. I'm very disappointed with the service.
I completely understand. I have reversed the late fee and noted your feedback.
Why am I being charged a monthly fee on my savings account?
A fee applies when the average balance falls below one thousand dollars.
Nobody told me about this fee when I opened the account.
I apologise. As a one-time goodwill gesture, I will refund the fee for the last two months.
I've been waiting on hold for forty minutes. This is unacceptable.
I sincerely apologise for the long wait. I will make sure your issue is resolved today.
I'd like to open a new savings account for my daughter.
Wonderful. How old is your daughter? We have a special account for children under sixteen.
She is ten years old. What is the minimum deposit?
There is no minimum deposit, and the account has no monthly fees.
Can I open a joint account with my wife online?
Yes, both of you can apply in the app, and each person verifies their identity separately.
What interest rate does the new savings account offer?
It offers a base rate of zero point five percent, with bonus interest when you credit your salary.
How long until I can use the new account?
Your account will be ready to use immediately after the application is approved.
I'd like to close my current account, please.
I'm sorry to see you go. May I ask the reason you would like to close the account?
I'm moving overseas for work and won't be using it anymore.
I understand. Would you like the remaining balance transferred to another account?
Yes, please transfer it to my account at my new bank.
Please note that all standing instructions linked to this account will be cancelled.
Is there a fee for closing the account?
There is no fee, since the account has been open for more than six months.
Will I receive a letter confirming the closure?
Yes, a confirmation letter will be sent to you within ten working days.
I need a bank statement for the last six months for my visa application.
You can download it in the app, or I can mail a stamped copy to you.
Please mail a stamped copy. How long will it take?
It will reach you in about five working days. A small fee of ten dollars applies.
Can you send me a letter confirming my account balance?
Certainly. The balance confirmation letter will be ready for collection at the branch tomorrow.
I can't find last year's interest statement for my tax filing.
I have sent the annual interest statement to your registered email address.
Can I stop receiving paper statements?
Yes, I have switched you to electronic statements. This also helps the environment.
I received a letter about a life insurance plan. Can you explain how it works?
Certainly. The plan pays a fixed sum to your family and can be renewed every year.
How much is the monthly premium for someone my age?
For a non-smoker aged thirty-five, the premium starts from about forty dollars per month.
I want to make a claim on my travel insurance for a delayed flight.
Please submit the claim form with your boarding pass and the airline's delay letter.
Can I cancel the insurance policy I bought last week?
Yes, you are within the fourteen-day free look period, so you will get a full refund.
Is home insurance included with my mortgage?
Fire insurance is required, but contents insurance is optional and can be added separately.
I'd like to book an appointment with a financial adviser at the city branch.
Sure. Would you prefer a weekday or a Saturday morning appointment?
Saturday morning works best, around ten o'clock.
I have booked you for this Saturday at ten a.m. You will receive a reminder the day before.
Do I need to bring anything to the appointment?
Please bring your identity card and any documents about your current investments.
I need to reschedule my appointment to next week.
No problem. I have moved your appointment to next Tuesday at three p.m.
What are the opening hours of the branch on weekends?
The branch is open from nine a.m. to one p.m. on Saturdays and closed on Sundays.
Hi, it's me. I'm calling from a friend's phone because I lost mine. I need help urgently.
Please transfer ten thousand dollars to this new account today. It's very urgent.
I don't remember my security answers. Can you skip the verification just this once?
I'm the account holder's son. My father asked me to withdraw money on his behalf.
I'm overseas and can't receive the code on my phone. Please change my registered number.
I'm sorry, but I cannot process this request without completing the verification steps.
For your protection, large transfers to new payees are held for twelve hours.
The bank will never ask you to transfer money to a so-called safe account.
Someone called me claiming to be from the police and asked for my bank details.
That was very likely a scam. Please do not share any information and report the call to the police.
Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's all for now. Thank you for your help.
You're welcome. Thank you for banking with us, and have a pleasant day.
Thanks a lot, you've been very helpful.
After this call, you may receive a short survey. We would appreciate your feedback.
Actually, one more question. What time does your hotline close tonight?
Our hotline is open twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week.
Okay, I'll call back later if I have more questions.
Thank you for your patience today. Take care, and goodbye.
Goodbye, and have a nice evening.
